claim_boundaries.constructed_reference_only: The inherited constructed pure-reflection correspondent remains a deterministic reference, not recovered fixture truth, an observed image, a counterfactual rollout or an independent measurement.
claim_boundaries.exactness_domain: Exact means equality over rational interpretations of pinned finite binary floating-point values. It does not authenticate source precision, physical truth, uncertainty or measurement accuracy.
claim_boundaries.no_classification_or_ranking: No square root, threshold, tolerance or normalization is used, and no row is classified or ranked for distance, triangle inequality, angle, similarity, collinearity, conditioning, quality or acceptance.
claim_boundaries.not_primary_endpoint: Rows have no request-start, generated-horizon or executed-time correspondence. They are not r0,rhat,r and answer neither A7 nor any A1-A9 question.
claim_boundaries.residual_space_not_physical_metric: Squared norms and dot products are algebra on retained residual vectors. They do not measure physical edge lengths, object separations, image footprints, silhouettes, angles, areas or metric quality.
claim_boundaries.science_annotation_and_release: No raw bytes, labels, manifest, annotation eligibility, inference, forecast metric, current-state claim, stage gate, dispatch authority or confirmation release follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_and_confounding: The three mapping pairs remain availability-selected. D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership. No layout, command, model, task-success, population, representation or camera effect is estimated.

construction_semantics.fixed_order_and_cycle: A=banana,B=bowl,C=rubiks_cube; eAB=A-B,eAC=A-C,eBC=B-C, so the tested fixed-order cycle is eAB+eBC-eAC=0.
construction_semantics.polarization_formula_ab_ac: The ab_ac residual is 2*(eAB dot eAC) - (||eAB||^2 + ||eAC||^2 - ||eBC||^2).
construction_semantics.polarization_formula_ab_bc: The ab_bc residual is 2*(eAB dot eBC) - (||eAC||^2 - ||eAB||^2 - ||eBC||^2).
construction_semantics.polarization_formula_ac_bc: The ac_bc residual is 2*(eAC dot eBC) - (||eAC||^2 + ||eBC||^2 - ||eAB||^2).
construction_semantics.polarization_identities: For each frozen row, exact rational arithmetic verifies the three equivalent squared-norm/dot-product identities induced by the edge cycle. No square root, normalization, tolerance or threshold is used.
construction_semantics.stored_coordinate_domain: Each finite JSON edge coordinate is interpreted as its exact binary floating-point rational value. Integer numerator/denominator strings control equality; approximate numbers are display aids only.
construction_semantics.units_and_scope: World scalar records use stored m coordinates and m^2 products; projected records use stored px coordinates and px^2 products. These are residual-vector-space coordinate identities, not measured physical lengths, distances, angles, areas or image-object geometry.

finding: All 9 world and 36 projected retained residual-triangle rows have zero exact rational eAB+eBC-eAC cycle residual and satisfy all three exact polarization identities. The package serializes 504 exact rational records and revalidates 180 Turn2852 exact scalars. This is a deterministic stored-coordinate consistency check only, not physical or scientific evidence.
